zh.title: 新功能
items: **桌面工作台升级**：浏览器和文档改为与会话绑定的横向标签页，可在同一会话中持续查看网页与文件，并在切换会话时保持内容归属清晰。
**Quick Chat 浮窗体验**：新增更紧凑的选择浮层与独立快捷对话窗口，改善窗口定位、尺寸和跨窗口会话同步。
**Goal Runner 持续执行**：补齐目标接收、自动推进、失败历史折叠和主窗口流路由，让已接受的目标能更稳定地交给 Runner 连续完成。
**TUI 完整交互链路**：新增计划审批、权限确认、模式限定工具、会话保存与恢复，并优化欢迎页、输入区、命令选择器、Markdown 与 diff 展示。
**模型与凭证支持扩展**：新增 Grok 官方订阅通道，改善模型发现和元数据展示，并统一 Desktop 与 TUI 的凭证存储与解析。
**跨平台发布能力增强**：补充 macOS 签名、图标与更新发布流程，并完善共享 Rust 核心和 CLI 集成。

zh.title: 优化
items: 长会话渲染、自动上下文压缩和运行时预检更加高效，压缩状态会严格归属当前会话。
模型目录加载、渠道列表、启动过渡、侧栏分隔和版本入口等桌面细节得到统一优化。
Quick Chat、TUI 输入器和动画效果进一步收敛视觉层级，波纹动画改为合成器友好的实现。
归档会话入口移入设置，工作台标签和状态栏布局更紧凑、易于理解。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复桌面安装包遗漏 `conversation-store` 运行时入口、导致应用启动时报 `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` 的问题，并新增打包产物入口完整性检查。
修复切换页面、模式或窗口时，过期的空消息快照可能覆盖并清空完整聊天历史的问题；消息文件写入改为更安全的原子替换。
修复非当前会话的 Browser 工具误展开网页面板，以及隐藏的 Browser WebView 仍可能显示的问题。
修复 Quick Chat 刷新、窗口切换和跨窗口状态同步不及时的问题。
修复 Goal 流被错误路由、计划恢复后无法继续，以及失败计划历史干扰当前执行的问题。
修复上下文压缩未真正生效、压缩状态串到其他会话和恢复会话状态不完整的问题。
修复模型提供方配置互相污染、认证字段冗余和凭证解析不一致的问题。
修复 TUI 命令选择器遮挡、临时提示残留及恢复会话时状态不同步的问题。

en.title: What's New
items: **Desktop workbench upgrade**: Browser and documents become session-bound horizontal tabs so pages and files stay with the session when you switch chats.
**Quick Chat floating UX**: More compact pickers and a dedicated quick-chat window with better placement, size, and cross-window session sync.
**Goal Runner continuous execution**: Completes goal accept, auto-advance, failed-history collapse, and main-window stream routing so accepted goals finish more reliably under the Runner.
**Full TUI interaction path**: Plan approval, permission confirm, mode-scoped tools, session save/restore, plus welcome, input, command picker, Markdown, and diff polish.
**Broader model & credential support**: Official Grok subscription channel, better model discovery/metadata, and unified credential storage/resolve for Desktop and TUI.
**Stronger cross-platform release**: macOS signing/icons/update pipeline plus shared Rust core and CLI integration.

en.title: Improvements
items: More efficient long-session render, auto-compact, and runtime preflight; compact state is strictly session-owned.
Unified desktop details for model catalog loading, channel lists, launch transition, sidebar splitters, and version entry.
Quick Chat, TUI input, and animation hierarchy tightened; ripple animation is compositor-friendly.
Archived-session entry moves into Settings; workbench tabs and status bar are denser and clearer.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fixed packaged app missing `conversation-store` runtime entry (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`) and added packaged entry integrity checks.
Fixed stale empty message snapshots overwriting full chat history when switching page/mode/window; message file writes use safer atomic replace.
Fixed Browser tools from non-current sessions expanding the web panel, and hidden Browser WebViews still showing.
Fixed Quick Chat refresh, window switch, and cross-window sync lag.
Fixed Goal streams mis-routed, plans unable to continue after restore, and failed plan history interfering with current runs.
Fixed compaction not actually applying, compact state leaking across sessions, and incomplete session restore.
Fixed provider config cross-contamination, redundant auth fields, and inconsistent credential resolve.
Fixed TUI command picker occlusion, sticky temporary tips, and desynced restore state.
